title: Warm Wholesome Mexican Meat Birria
description: A hearty and comforting Mexican dish featuring tender beef, sweet and spicy sauce, and crunchy tortillas, all served in a warm stone bowl. This diabetic-friendly birria is perfect for a weekend brunch or a special occasion meal.

ingredients.name: cocoa powder
ingredients.notes: adds a rich and complex flavor

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: adds a warm and earthy flavor

instructions: Heat lard or vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef brisket pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cocoa powder, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the birria by placing a portion of the meat mixture onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the sweet and spicy sauce, and finally a sprinkle of fresh cilantro.
Garnish with lime wedges, onion slices, and cilantro, if desired.
